name: IP Geolocation
tagline: Locate any IP address — country, city, ISP
description: Look up geographic and network information for any IPv4 or IPv6 address: country, region, city, ISP, organization, timezone, and coordinates. Uses the free ip-api.com service — no API key required.

inputs.name: ip
inputs.label: IP Address (leave blank for your IP)

expert_defs.name: ip_geolocation_lookup
expert_defs.description: Returns geolocation and network info for an IP address using ip-api.com. Param: ip (IPv4/IPv6 string, or blank for caller's IP). Returns JSON with output_type json containing country, city, ISP, timezone, lat/lon.
code: result = {'ip': data.get('query'), 'country': data.get('country'), 'country_code': data.get('countryCode'), 'region': data.get('regionName'), 'city': data.get('city'), 'zip': data.get('zip'), 'timezone': data.get('timezone'), 'isp': data.get('isp'), 'org': data.get('org'), 'coordinates': {'lat': data.get('lat'), 'lon': data.get('lon')}}

conceptTexts: Plugin: IP Geolocation (id: ip-geolocation). Expert ip_geolocation_lookup looks up country, city, ISP, timezone and coordinates for any IP using ip-api.com (free). Param: ip (IPv4/IPv6, or blank for caller's IP). Returns {output_type: 'json', data: {ip, country, region, city, timezone, isp, coordinates}}.
